answer_4.quote: We conduct human annotation on 1,000 sampled utterances in each augmented test set of Multi-WOZ. We ask annotators to check whether our augmented utterances are reasonable and our autodetected value annotations are correct (two true-orfalse questions). ... For TP and SD, annotators check whether the meaning of utterances and dialog acts are unchanged. For WP, changing slot values is allowed due to slot value replacement, but the slot name should be the same. For SR, annotators are asked to judge on the similarity of pronunciation rather than semantics.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer true/false questions checking (1) if the augmented utterance is reasonable, (2) if the dialog act annotation is correct; specific protocols: TP & SD – meaning unchanged; WP – slot name unchanged, slot value may change; SR – pronunciation similarity.
